findings.evidence: The conclusions contain no decidable-equality data, while the instance is used only by proof-level direct-sum/finite-index computations; the finrank specialization at Module.lean:284 already successfully obtains it locally with `classical`.
findings.fix: Remove the section-level instance and use `classical` inside the proofs; likewise remove `[DecidableEq Q]` from the quiver Internal section.
findings.issue: `[DecidableEq ι]` unnecessarily strengthens `smul_coeLinearMap_smul_top`, `isInternal_smul_top`, and `coe_ofBijective_coeLinearMap_symm_apply_smul_top`; the same leak propagates as `[DecidableEq Q]` to both internal vertex-component theorems at lines 236 and 243.

findings.evidence: Mathlib's `Module.finrank_directSum` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:255` requires only `[Fintype ι]`; decidable equality is needed only to elaborate the direct-sum machinery used by this proof.
findings.fix: Drop `[DecidableEq ι]` and add `classical` in the proof before the existing rewrite.
findings.issue: `finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_isInternal` exposes an unnecessary `[DecidableEq ι]` assumption in a general dimension theorem.

summary: Several public decomposition APIs unnecessarily require decidable equality on the index type, despite their statements being noncomputable and naturally needing only finiteness.
